subject: Under Siege (Netflix)
query: is under siege on netflix a true story
title: Is Under Siege on Netflix a true story? The 1985 Bogotá siege
answer: Yes. Netflix's "Under Siege" ("Palacio" in Spanish) is based on a real event: on Nov. 6, 1985, guerrillas of Colombia's M-19 movement seized the Palace of Justice in Bogotá and took about 300 hostages, including Supreme Court justices. The army's counterattack lasted about 28 hours, and more than 90 people were killed or went missing.
body:
The eight-part Colombian series premieres on Nov. 6, 2026, the 41st anniversary of the attack. It comes from Dynamo, the company behind "Narcos," with showrunner Natalia Santa, who also wrote Netflix's "One Hundred Years of Solitude." The cast includes Natalia Reyes, Carlos Manuel Vesga and Robinson Díaz. The story follows the hostages and soldiers, and then the families who spent two decades looking for relatives who never came home.

Eleven Supreme Court magistrates died, among them Chief Justice Alfonso Reyes Echandía. At least 11 people, mostly workers from the building's cafeteria, were reported missing after the siege; the remains of some were identified only years later. A former hitman claimed Pablo Escobar paid the M-19 to destroy court records on extradition, but a 1986 government inquiry could not prove it.

The disappearances led to decades of trials. Army Colonel Alfonso Plazas Vega was sentenced to 30 years in 2010 and later acquitted, while retired General Jesús Armando Arias Cabrales received 35 years. The M-19 laid down its arms in 1990 and became a political party.
in_the_news: Netflix's Colombian drama "Under Siege" premieres on Nov. 6, 2026, the anniversary of the 1985 Palace of Justice siege it depicts.

faq.q: What is Under Siege on Netflix about?
faq.a: It dramatizes the Nov. 6, 1985 takeover of Colombia's Palace of Justice by M-19 guerrillas, the army's assault to retake it, and the long search by victims' families for the missing.

faq.q: How many episodes is Under Siege?
faq.a: Eight episodes, all released on Netflix on Nov. 6, 2026.
